Seq35 slice3 (verified: decompile + table dump 0x594DF8..0x594FF8). Per-language upper-casing of ONE font code (codes are glyph-font-relative, NOT Latin-1).
lang 'e': a-z (0x61..0x7A) -> -0x20 only.  'f': a-z, then 0x80..0xFF via g_UpperCaseTable_F[code-0x80] (accented lowercase -> plain ASCII capital, except 0x9B->0x84, 0x9C->0x85). Also used by ApplyCheats (0x4590F0) to hash the profile name (so cheat names are ASCII-only). Hazard: static buffer, each call overwrites the previous result. Copies src->dest wchar by wchar, measuring with Text glyph advance (FUN_004539d0(font,ch)) and space advance (FUN_004c23d0(font)). LF(0x0A) resets the line (count++).
